title: Claude Code Just Added Routines (Here's How They Work)
description:
Anthropic added routines to Claude Code. Write a prompt once, set a schedule or trigger, and Claude runs it automatically. Works with Gmail, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive. Pro gets 5 per day, Max gets 15. It just dropped as a research preview, so it's only getting better from here.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Tbj9MsHIG4PTd3jEjlXn6YvBnL7wfxcEffMvuP7oAl0/edit
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
transcript: Here's everything you need to know about Claude's new routines feature. You can write a prompt once, pick a schedule, and Claude runs it automatically from that point forward. I have one that reviews every pull request overnight, and by morning the reviews are done without me touching anything. Another one compiles a weekly report from my commits every Friday at 5:00. It connects to Gmail, GitHub, Slack, and Google Drive. So, your briefs, your reports, and your updates all happen on their own. Comment routine and I'll send you the setup guide.
